powerplant.description: CargoSub uses a conventional, straight forward nuclear reactor to generate steam for a main propulsion steam turbine and a small steam engine for electrical power generation. Electrical generation steam engine is owned and controlled as part of the electrical system. The powerplant merely provides steam. Both steam engines exhaust into four condensers, returning feedwater to the boiler. Besides normal operation, the powerplant and its controller monitor and control maintenance activities like nuclear refueling, opening/closing the RPV, supplying fresh water to the RPV and boiler, and topping up the fresh water supply with the desalinator.

RPV.description: The Reactor Pressure Vessel is the normally sealed and fully flooded custom tank containing the fuel rod assemblies and control rods. Control systems are expected to be good, so the total RPV volume is minimized to reduce response lag.
RPV.top_hatch: The top of the RPV is a custom door that can be unsealed and opened for refueling.
RPV.freshwater_topping: Two dedicated fluid ports in the RPV can be used with pumps to fill the RPV with freshwater, or remove water, returning it to the freshwater tank (the game doesn't simulate radioactive water contamination) or dumping it overboard.
RPV.sensors: A radiation detector (geiger counter) is mounted inside the RPV, exactly above the fuel assemblies' centerline. It is used to calculate reactivity as counts per second. A temperature sensor is used to monitor average coolant temperature. All fuel rod assemblies indicate their own individual temperatures, which are monitored. Finally, there is a liquid sensor for water pressure and percent capacity.

reactor_coolant_loop.description: The normal flow, starting with the hot leg, is from the RPV high fluid port, to ReactorCoolantPump(s), to ReactorCoolantVariableValve, to BoilerCoolantA. The cold leg returns from BoilerCoolantB to the RPV low fluid port.

physical_arrangement.heat_dump: To rapidly reduce reactor coolant temperature during rapid power reductions or scrams, a dedicated heat exchanger loop removes heat through a liquid-liquid seawater heat exchanger. This heat dump loop has its own connection ports to the RPV.

boiler.description: Heat from the reactor coolant loop converts feedwater to steam. Boiler temperature is regulated at some number just above 100 degrees C by closed loop control of the reactor coolant flow rate. Feedwater flow rate is used to regulate steam production, either to a target EngRPS (feedwater regulation), or to a target steam chest pressure (main steam valve regulation). The boiler and downstream steam system will have overpressure protection logic via feedwater throttling. The overpressure valve is also used to dump steam during rapid power reductions and scrams.

steam_loops.description: There are two pseudo-coupled steam loops, and an overpressure relief valve. Steam from the boiler enters the steam chest, a large gas tank. From the steam xhest, steam can take two paths, to the main propulsion steam engine, and the power generation steam engine. Both engines have a throttling variable flow valve upstream, and both exhaust into the same condenser bank. The power generation loop has a steam demand dramatically smaller than main steam propulsion.
steam_loops.main_propulsion_engine: Downstream of the steam chest, steam flows through the main throttle valve to a large steam turbine engine. The condensers downstream maintain a near-vacuum backpressure for efficiency. EngRPS is connected via gearbox directly to the giant variable pitch propeller. Main screw reversing is unanticipated, backing being achieved with PropPitch.
steam_loops.power_gen_engine: The power generation ateam engine is owned and regulated by the electrical system, but steam pressure and flowrate are measured as a load demand. The propulsion system sets a SteamAvailable flag that that is used to indicate to the electrical system that it is acceptable to use steam.
steam_loops.condenser_bank: Both engines exhaust to a bank of parallel condensers. During powerplant operation, seawater coolant is continuously pumped at full power through the condensors. The generated freshwater levels are monitored and regulated by pumps and valves, returning water to the freshwater (feedwater) tanks.

powerplant.freshwater_system: A large freshwater tank provides freshwater to the boiler (feedwater) and RPV for refilling. Makeup feedwater is produced by a desalinator. A large flyid pump and variable flow valve just upsyream of the boiler are used to regulate feedwater flow.

control_loop_throttle_valve.description: Regulates transient and short term EngRPS with the main throttling valve. For rapid power reductions, a steam bypass valve can dump steam overboard to prevent an overpressure.

control_loop_feedwater_valve.description: Regulates steady state EngRPS with feedwater flow rate.

control_loop_coolant_valve.description: Regulates boiler temperature with reactor coolant flow rate.

control_loop_control_rods.description: Regulates the coolant temperature via a two loop cascade. The outer loop sets a reactivity setpoint to directly regulate the coolant temperature. The inner loop regulates reactivity with control rod position. Reactivity is measured as counts per second of a radiation detector (Geiger counter) placed above the fuel assembly in the RPV. When ReactorRunReq = 0 (SCRAM/shutdown) closed loop control is reset, and control rod position commanded to 0.0. For rapid, non-SCRAM power reductions, before reactivity can be brought down, reactor coolant is routed through a liquid/liquid heat exchanger to dump heat faster. For now, this logic will be included in the main coolant temp loops.

powerplant_supervisor_logic.description: Manages the status flags, modes, and other ancilliary non-loop aspects of the powerplant

ReactorRunReq.description: If ReactorRunReq AND ReactorSafeToRun then do the conditions_met actions. Else, do the conditions_not_met actions.
conditions_met: Allow the control loops to run each frame
Reactor coolant, feedwater, condenser coolant pumps on.
conditions_not_met: As various temperatures and pressures acheive steady state, turn off the relavent pumps, and close the steam bypass valve.

powerplant_supervisor_logic.feedwater_makeup: The freshwater tank will be nearly full when the powerplant is shut down, but the tank level will drop and vary during operation due to its use in the steam loops and as a liquid in condensers. Based on actual testing, a suitable control system for desalinator operation will be implimented.
